labs.location: Mailbox 100, Harvard Kennedy School, 79 John F. Kennedy Street, Cambridge, Massachusetts 02138
labs.research_summary: Kennedy School program that researches gender equity at work, in politics and in conflict, hosts gender-focused research fellows and keeps an open portal of evidence on policies that close gender gaps.
labs.join_notes: Offers unpaid research fellowships of one or two semesters, residential or non-residential, for PhD candidates and post-PhD scholars doing gender research in one of the program's three focus areas. Applicants email a cover letter, CV, project description of up to five pages, one writing sample and two recommendation letters to wappp_fellowships@hks.harvard.edu; the next deadline is Feb. 1, 2027. No staff jobs are listed on the pages read.
labs.notes: Hannah Riley Bowles is the other Co-Director, and Nicole Carter Quinn is Executive Director. The People Directory (https://www.hks.harvard.edu/centers/wappp/about/people) runs over two pages; its filters show 3 center leadership, 7 staff, 12 fellows, 22 affiliated faculty and 1 student. Only page 1 was read, and research fellows may be non-residential, so no count. No general email or phone appears on the pages read (the Contact Us page was not read); the fellowship inbox is recorded in join_notes only.
